* Services promote healthy pregnancies, safe home environments and strong parent-child relationships.
* Staff use developmental screenings to help track a child’s growth and identify early needs.
* Families receive parenting support, breastfeeding guidance, mental health and wellness checks and connection to community resources.
* Staff help families set and meet personal goals related to school, work, health or parenting.
* Referrals to community programs, insurance support, health care services and social support are provided based on each family’s needs.
* All services are free of cost to eligible San Mateo County families.
